title: uxcd ubus API
description: Response shapes for the uxcd ubus object. The live method + feature contract is returned by the 'api' method; see docs/ubus-api.md for the per-method reference. Objects use additionalProperties:true so new fields do not invalidate a client.

api.description: Response of the 'api' method: the self-describing contract.

api_version.description: ubus API contract version; bumped only on a breaking change.

methods.description: Registered ubus methods, generated from the same table that is served. Maps method name to its parameter type hints.

features.description: Capability flags a client can key on (e.g. multi_stage, ipv6, safe_update).

container.description: A container. 'list' returns a summary of each, keyed by container name (an object whose KEYS are the names, exactly as 'job_list' is keyed by job id); 'info' returns the full config-derived detail for one. Only 'info' sets a 'name' field - in a 'list' entry the name is the object KEY, so it is intentionally absent from 'required' (mirroring how 'job.id' is the job_list key).

name.description: Container name. Set by 'info'; in a 'list' response the name is the object KEY (like 'job.id' in 'job_list'), so per-entry objects omit it.

image.description: Image reference the bundle was built from.

uptime.description: Seconds since the current launch (running only).

memory.description: Current memory use in bytes (running only).

cpu_usec.description: Cumulative CPU time in microseconds; clients derive a percentage from successive samples.

pid.description: ujail pid of the container's init.

update_available.description: A newer image was found by the update check (for a built container: its base image moved, or its Dockerfile changed).

update_rebuild.description: The available update is a REBUILD, not a pull: the container was built here and upgrade re-runs its Dockerfile.

built.description: Built from a Dockerfile on this box rather than pulled; provenance is the 'build' block instead of image/digest.

recipe.description: Recipe this container was deployed from, if any.

update_digest.description: Digest the image reference currently resolves to.

config_changed.description: Config edited since launch; restart to apply.

fault.description: Non-empty when a start failed (e.g. port already in use).

last_update.description: Result of the last upgrade attempt, e.g. 'rolled_back'.

build.description: Build provenance of a container built from a Dockerfile on this box. The build-mode counterpart of image+digest: an upgrade re-BUILDS from this instead of pulling, so a customised rootfs is never replaced by the stock base image. An entry carries this OR image/digest, never both.

dockerfile.description: Absolute path of the Dockerfile the bundle was built from; a rebuild re-runs it.

dockerfile_sha256.description: sha256 of the Dockerfile at build time; the update check re-hashes it to notice an edited recipe.

base.description: The final stage's FROM ref - the image the update check follows.

base_digest.description: That ref resolved at build time; a rebuild is due when it no longer matches.

recipe.description: Recipe that generated the Dockerfile, if any.

profile.description: Profile overlay applied at build time; re-applied on a rebuild.

web_port.description: A web interface the container serves; the overview's globe button opens it.

event.description: An entry in the daemon event timeline (the 'events' method) and the payload broadcast on the 'uxcd.container' ubus event.

started | exited | adopted | gave_up | healthy | unhealthy | heartbeat | update_check | update_available | new_version | auto_upgrade | upgraded | update_verified | rolled_back | rollback_failed | infra_failed | scheduled_restart | scheduled_stop | scheduled_start | renamed | disk_low

name.description: Container name; empty for daemon-wide events (update_check, heartbeat).

signal.description: On 'exited': the signal that killed it, if any.

exit_code.description: On 'exited': the process exit code, if any.

label.description: Human label (e.g. image ref or Dockerfile).

upgrade.description: This pull is part of an upgrade re-pull.
